chat_history.content: Build a workflow that opens https://example.com and extracts the main heading. Do not run it. Then create a signed webhook trigger for this workflow so another system can start it; leave the trigger off.

I built the agent and created the signed webhook trigger. Nothing has been run, so the agent is untested.

**Agent: "Extract example.com main heading"** (staged as a proposal; accept it to save)
- It opens `https://example.com`, waits for the page text to appear, and returns `main_heading`.
- It also returns `heading_source`, which says where the heading came from.
- **The page has no heading element.** When I inspected it, it had no `h1`, `h2` or `h3`. The only place "Example Domain" appears is the document title. The screenshot shows the same thing: just the notice text and a "Learn more" link.
- The agent reads the first `h1` if there is one. Otherwise it falls back to the page title, which should give `Example Domain` with `heading_source` set to `document_title`.

**Trigger: signed webhook**
- Its ID is `etr_596979605654677482`, and it is **switched off**.
- It has no input mapping, because the agent takes no inputs.
- It will reject every event until someone clicks **Rotate secret** on it in the Triggers panel and gives the new secret to the sending system. The secret is never shown in this chat.
- To start the agent from another system, turn the trigger on in the Triggers panel after rotating the secret.

+await page.goto("https://example.com")
+await page.locator("p").first.wait_for(state="visible")

+if await h1.count() > 0:

proposed_workflow.title: Extract example.com heading with signed webhook trigger

blocks.label: extract_main_heading
blocks.prompt: The example.com page is open, showing its documentation-domain notice, and main_heading holds the page's main heading text (Example Domain) with heading_source saying where it was read from. The block opens https://example.com, waits for the page body paragraph to appear, then reads the first h1 on the page and, if the page has none, falls back to the document title.

proposed_workflow._copilot_yaml:
title: Extract example.com heading with signed webhook trigger
workflow_definition:
  parameters: []
  blocks:
  - block_type: code
    label: extract_main_heading
    prompt: The example.com page is open, showing its documentation-domain notice,
      and main_heading holds the page's main heading text (Example Domain) with heading_source
      saying where it was read from. The block opens https://example.com, waits for
      the page body paragraph to appear, then reads the first h1 on the page and,
      if the page has none, falls back to the document title.
    code: "await page.goto(\"https://example.com\")\nawait page.locator(\"p\").first.wait_for(state=\"\
      visible\")\nh1 = page.locator(\"h1\").first\nif await h1.count() > 0:\n    heading\
      \ = (await h1.inner_text()).strip()\n    source = \"h1\"\nelse:\n    heading\
      \ = (await page.title()).strip()\n    source = \"document_title\"\nreturn {\"\
      main_heading\": heading, \"heading_source\": source}"
    data_schema:
      type: object
      properties:
        main_heading:
          type: string
        heading_source:
          type: string
      required:
      - main_heading
      - heading_source
    steps:
    - description: Open https://example.com
      action_type: goto_url
      line_start: 1
      line_end: 1
    - description: Extract heading
      action_type: extract
      line_start: 5
      line_end: 5
